text:
maria: Seeing a spike in NVLink flaps on rack13-node07 during the midday batch runs. Jobs hit 30-40% tail latency and OOMs when we fall back to host memcpy.
infra-bot: alert: node rack13-node07 nvlink_flap_rate=6m:4 events \u270A  (detected by nvlink-monitor)
kevin: can you paste the dmesg AER/Xid lines?
sasha: logs from node attached: 
```
[ 1234.567890] pcieport 0000:3b:00.0: AER: Multiple Corrected error received: ID 00e0
[ 1234.567901] nvidia 0000:3c:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:3c:00): 31, CE on PF
[ 1235.001234] nvlink: link 1 down, retrying
[ 1235.005678] nvidia 0000:3c:00.0: GPU-UUID: GPU-abcdef1234
```
kevin: GPU 3 shows repeated link-downs, but ECC counters are low -> likely physical link (riser/cable) or firmware timing.
maria: perf graph: nvlink bw drops 90% for 10s windows, then recovers. This correlates with our multi-GPU shard failures.
daniel: can we cordon/drain the node for next maintenance window? impact on queued capacity: two big jobs scheduled in us-west-2 zone.
sasha: quick mitigation: set model affinity to avoid cross-node allreduce for affected jobs + drop batch from 8->4, reduces tail by ~30%.
kevin: ops plan: 1) cordon rack13-node07 now (no new pods) 2) graceful drain during 04:00 UTC, 3) RMA card or reseat riser if reseating reduces flaps, 4) firmware update if reseat fails.
maria: any immediate rollback? we just hit two customer retries.
daniel: routing: add temporary soft-capacity by spinning up 2x spot g4dn/nd instances to absorb the queued jobs for 6h. Cost estimate: ~$180/hr extra until repaired.
sasha: I'll run nvlink-monitor --dump and capture per-link error counters. Also will add a short-term prefix cache bypass to avoid cross-GPU communication during regen.
infra-bot: ticket created: INC-2026-3174 - nvlink link flaps rack13-node07. Assigned to @kevin.
kevin: thanks. i'll update runbook with the riser reseat steps and the kernel oops grep to watch: `dmesg | egrep \"AER|nvlink|Xid\"`
maria: tagging @oncall to keep eyes on compaction jobs. :eyes:
daniel: noted. If reseat doesn't fix it, we'll schedule node replacement and trigger capacity increase for the zone.
sasha: added a short probe that will route new allreduce jobs away from nodes with nvlink errors for 2h. will revert after 6h if stable.
kevin: leaving this open. will post post-drain findings and whether HW swap fixed the flaps. :thumbsup:
